truthRule: Every inserted occurrence must identify an exact cross-file project symbol. For Vue component default imports, the imported local name, component tag sites, resolved component file, and persisted synthetic default-export symbol must agree. Same-file bindings and definitions without an exact base-index symbol are disclosed but not inserted.

capability.scope: cross-file Vue component identities and exact-name base-index symbols
capability.unsupportedBoundary: general local-binding identity and cross-file properties absent from the base SCIP definition catalog

falsePositiveArchetypesRemoved: all same-file bindings collapsed onto the SFC default-export symbol
object properties attributed to a nearby enclosing callable
identifier-looking module-path fragments inserted as symbol references
